protocol: Modified in-flight EVA profile. Dragon was depressurized with four crew aboard. The team changed the phase structure, environment setpoints and suit pressure after ground validation.
outcome_window: Observed in-flight profile. A fixed symptom ascertainment window and post-flight surveillance are unreported.
locator: Rosenberg et al. 2026 IEEE Aerospace Conference author abstract, in-flight physiology and final outcome paragraphs
note: The authors report no observed DCS symptoms across the two profiles and describe physiological measurements for all four crewmembers in flight. The four also participated in the eight-person ground validation. A flight VGE count is unreported. Do not pool with ground validation or operational chamber incidence.

protocol: An RNZAF aviator trainee suffered a reported air embolus after rapid decompression and received recompression at Philomel. The treatment report gives no exposure location, pressures, gas history or treatment regimen.
outcome_window: Flying-training disposition reported. The author could not follow up this aviator.
locator: Sutherland 1990 pp. 4–5, Cases treated and The worst cases
note: The report records one aviator deemed unfit to continue flying training. Permanent cerebral damage was suspected by the author, with no individual follow-up or documented confirmation. The selected treatment series supplies no training exposure denominator. Likely overlaps the 1988 RNZAF AGE described by Harding.
